data.name: ItinerarySubtitle
data.value: A full day: we meet you at the airport or in town, drive you in comfort to the highlights of the coast and bring you back in the evening.

data.name: ItineraryNote
data.value: The order and availability of stops may change with the weather — the North always has the final say.

data.name: Itinerary1Text
data.value: We collect you at the airport, the railway station or an agreed point in Murmansk, and you settle into a comfortable minivan.

data.name: Itinerary2Text
data.value: About a two-hour drive past the Kola wind farm, the stone garden and tundra stretching to the horizon.

data.name: Itinerary3Text
data.value: Sample sea urchins, scallops, sea cucumbers and much more. Coffee, tea and snacks, restrooms and souvenirs are on hand too.

data.name: Itinerary4Text
data.value: Head out to sea with a chance to spot whales, orcas, seals and other marine mammals, as well as seabird colonies. Teriberka is well worth seeing from the water.

data.name: Itinerary5Text
data.value: A sandy beach, a whale skeleton, the throne and the ghost ship — plus reindeer and husky dogs.

data.name: Itinerary6Title
data.value: Lunch at an Arctic cuisine restaurant

data.name: Itinerary6Text
data.value: A set lunch or dishes from the menu. After lunch — the viewpoint and the famous “Edge of the Earth” sign.

data.name: Itinerary7Text
data.value: Logovo (the Lair), Dragon Eggs beach, Batareysky waterfall and viewpoints over the seabird colonies. We walk along wooden trails, and in winter we get around the park by snowmobile.

data.name: Itinerary8Text
data.value: After a full day we drive back and drop you at the agreed point in Murmansk.

data.name: Faq1Question
data.value: What if the road closes because of the weather?

data.name: Faq1Answer
data.value: Safety comes before the programme. We will contact you and offer a new date or another available route.

data.name: Faq2Answer
data.value: Coastal weather changes quickly. Bring a windproof outer layer, warm layers and shoes with non-slip soles.

data.name: Faq3Answer
data.value: Yes, but the route takes a full day and includes walks over rocky terrain. Tell the operator your child's age.

data.name: Faq4Question
data.value: Do I pay when I submit the form?

data.name: Faq4Answer
data.value: No. We first confirm the date, programme and final price; then you decide whether to book.

data.name: Faq5Answer
data.value: A full day: we leave Murmansk in the morning and return in the evening. We confirm exact times when you book — they depend on the season and daylight.

data.name: Faq6Question
data.value: What happens after I send a request?

data.name: Faq6Answer
data.value: We call you back on the number you gave, confirm the date, group size and wishes, and quote the final price. Booking happens only once you agree.

data.name: Why3Text
data.value: a request commits you to nothing: we call first, settle the date, the weather and the price, and only then do you say yes

data.name: MapSubtitle
data.value: Three destinations across the Kola Peninsula — every tour starts in Murmansk

data.name: Dir1Text
data.value: Dragon Eggs, the ship graveyard, a waterfall into the ocean and aurora hunting at the edge of the continent.

data.name: Dir2Text
data.value: Sacred Seydozero, the Geologists' Pass and the road to land's end — the Sredny and Rybachy peninsulas.

data.name: Dir3Text
data.value: Amethysts of Cape Korabl, the Kuzomen sands and Pomor villages by the White Sea.

data.name: RouteCustomText
data.value: We will build the programme around your dates, group and interests — from a single day to a week-long expedition across the Kola Peninsula.
